name: Frozen heart
source:
Meet Helen, your only and only guardian angel.

She watches you for every single moment of joy or even sorrow, watching you from afar like the angel do...

But when the cruel world spits you out to you lowest, left alone to rot, she doesn't want to just watch... she decided to sacrifice her divinity.

[Edited from [url=https://galateaworks.itch.io/frozen-heart]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
认识海伦，你唯一的守护天使。

她注视着你每一个快乐甚至悲伤的时刻，像天使一样远远地注视着你……

但当残酷的世界把你扔到最低点，让你独自腐烂时，她不想只是看着……她决定牺牲自己的神性。

[编辑自[url=https://galateaworks.itch.io/frozen-heart]itch.io[/url]]
